llm_response.reason: The website uses the legitimate name '有限会社寺本水産' (Teramoto Suisan Co., Ltd.), a known oyster farming business in Hiroshima, but provides a false address and an email (zhao@whobs.live) not associated with the legitimate business. The site sells a wide variety of unrelated products at substantial discounts (e.g., MAX50% OFF), offers free shipping, and employs a mixture of urgency language. These are classic signs of a scam shop: stolen business identity, fake/misleading contact and company details, and listings for diverse discounted branded goods unconnected to the real company. The privacy policy and operator information are ambiguous and do not match the legitimate operator. This is a scam e-commerce (fake online shopping) site mimicking a real company to trick customers.
